frozen_identity_9_fields.question: Will Ukraine recapture Crimean territory by December 31, 2026?

gamma.extraction: Only createdAt, startDate and frozen identity fields were extracted; no price fields included.

geometry.current_inventory: No operational layer titled Crimea, administrative boundary, or coastline. World Topographic Map Reference is a basemap vector-tile layer, not an exposed Crimea boundary. Separate static layer is Russian-controlled Ukrainian Territory Before Feb 24, 2022.

candidate_outline.use: territorial-control shading, not a dedicated Crimea administrative boundary; invalid polygon construction means it is not used as authoritative full Crimea mask.

geometry.all_73_method: Enumerated every vertex/ring of each dated Claimed Ukrainian Counteroffensives polygon; calculated feature bboxes in source lon/lat WKID4326 and bbox-screened (no reprojection or distances). Against candidate outer-ring bbox above: 0/72 Oct18 and 0/73 Oct20 intersect. Against broader screen [31.5,44,37,47]: Oct20 OID7 bbox [32.72050,46.65869,32.73261,46.66551], OID11 [31.25421,46.54882,33.97537,47.74848]; both north of candidate bbox. Oct18 corresponding OIDs 11 and 15. Broad northern/western Kherson/Mykolaiv extent (incl. possible Kinburn-area geometry) is not classified as Crimea.
geometry.limit: Only Oct18/20 snapshots, both after creation; no daily history from 2026-05-27 or intervening next-cycle evidence. No exact administrative boundary; bbox screening is not a definitive any-part polygon test and cannot establish historical occurrence/persistence.

caveat: No conclusion about qualifying event, map persistence, or absence of event.
